info.text:
Two tech giants plan to spend up to $425 billion in 2026.
Alphabet raised its 2026 capital spending plan to $195-$205 billion; Amazon raised its to about $220 billion (July 2026).
Alphabet spent $44.9 billion in Q2 2026, about double a year earlier. Microsoft spent $41 billion in its June quarter.
Microsoft and Alphabet report Oct 28; Amazon reports Oct 29.
Sources: Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft June-quarter reports; company releases.
News and education, not financial advice.
